narrative.intro: Frequentis Usa has $298M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Frequentis Usa received 9 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $33.1M, and obligations are up 90.8% year over year. Frequentis Usa obligations rose from $8.4M in FY21, then moved through $7.6M in FY22, $7.2M in FY23, $34.3M in FY24, and $156M in FY25 before reaching $298M in FY26. Frequentis Usa shows heavy concentration in Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing with $283M in obligations, followed by Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing at $9.6M. Frequentis Usa has smaller obligations in Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing at $3.9M, Engineering Services at $662K, Computer Systems Design Services at $100K, and Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $55.2K. Current-year totals are fiscal year to date and represent contract obligations except where award-value figures are noted in other tables.
